name: What factors influence the cost of kitchen drywall installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of kitchen drywall installation?

acceptedAnswer.text:
What affects the total cost of installing drywall in a kitchen?
The cost of kitchen drywall depends on room square footage, ceiling height, demolition needs, and the complexity of cutouts for plumbing, electrical boxes, and range vents. Kitchens contain significantly more outlets, switches, and rough-in piping than bedrooms, which increases labor time for measuring, cutting, and fitting panels. If your renovation involves removing old damaged plaster, moving a sink line, or framing an island or peninsula, the additional carpentry and wall preparation will also influence overall labor and disposal expenses.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen drywall costs depend on room size, wall height, repair complexity, and the number of precise cutouts needed for plumbing lines and electrical outlets.
